title.zh: 半導體人才招募｜晶圓、封測、IC 設計與設備材料｜HRK365
title.en: Semiconductor Recruitment in Taiwan | Fab, OSAT, IC Design & Equipment | HRK365

desc.zh: HRK365 半導體獵才服務：晶圓製造、封裝測試、IC 設計與設備材料的製程、設備、整合、良率與主管職。顧問來自台灣一線同業，熟悉竹科、中科與南科市場。
desc.en: HRK365's semiconductor search practice covers wafer fabrication, OSAT, IC design, and equipment and materials — process, equipment, integration, yield and leadership roles across Taiwan's science parks.

sub.zh: 這是 HRK365 來台灣的原因。晶圓製造、封裝測試、IC 設計到設備材料，從資深工程師到廠級主管，我們把整條供應鏈當成一個人才市場來看。
sub.en: This is why HRK365 came to Taiwan. Wafer fabrication, OSAT, IC design and equipment and materials — from senior engineers to plant leadership, we treat the whole supply chain as one talent market.

title.en: The shortage is people, not capacity

body.zh:
台灣握有全球最關鍵的一段半導體供應鏈。先進製程持續推進、封裝技術往 2.5D／3D 走、設備與材料的國產化需求上升——每一項都在同一批有限的人才池裡搶人。

這個市場的招募難度不在於「找不到履歷」，而在於：合適的人幾乎都在職、都有競業條款要處理、都有一批還沒到期的股票在綁著。要把人帶出來，靠的是對產業的理解與可信的關係，不是刊登職缺等人投遞。

這也是為什麼我們把半導體設為主力，而不是「我們也做半導體」。
body.en:
Taiwan holds the most critical stretch of the global semiconductor supply chain. Advanced nodes keep moving, packaging shifts toward 2.5D and 3D, and localisation of equipment and materials keeps accelerating — all competing for the same limited talent pool.

The difficulty here is not a shortage of CVs. It is that the right people are almost always employed, usually have a non-compete to work through, and usually have unvested stock holding them in place. Moving them takes industry understanding and credible relationships, not a job posting and patience.

That is why semiconductor is our core practice rather than a line on a list.

title.zh: 四個次產業，一套人才網絡

body.zh: 人才在這四塊之間流動。同時看四塊，才判斷得出一個人選的市場價值與可挖角性。
body.en: Talent moves between these four. Covering all of them is what makes it possible to judge a candidate's market value and whether they can realistically be moved.

title.zh: 半導體招募的四個現實

body.zh: 這些是每一個半導體職缺都會遇到的問題。顧問有沒有處理過，差別在成交與否。
body.en: Every semiconductor search runs into these. Whether your consultant has handled them before is the difference between an offer and a dead end.

bullets.zh: 競業禁止條款：適用範圍、補償是否給付、實務上的可執行性，必須在推薦前釐清，不能等到 offer 才發現。
bullets.en: Non-compete clauses — scope, whether compensation was actually paid, and real-world enforceability. This has to be clarified before shortlisting, not discovered at offer stage.

bullets.zh: 股票與分紅綁定：未到期的股票獎酬往往是留任的真正原因。談 offer 時要算得出補償缺口，否則人選最後會留下。
bullets.en: Unvested equity and bonuses — often the real reason someone stays. If the offer cannot quantify and bridge the gap, the candidate stays put.

bullets.zh: 輪班與駐廠型態：日夜班、四班二輪、駐廠支援的實際作息，講清楚才不會到職一個月就離職。
bullets.en: Shift and on-site patterns — day/night rotation, four-shift systems, on-site support. Spell out the real schedule or the hire quits within a month.

bullets.zh: 保密與利益迴避：客戶名單、專案資訊與人選身分都必須受控。同時服務多家同業時，迴避規則要事先講明。
bullets.en: Confidentiality and conflicts — client lists, project information and candidate identities must all be controlled, and the conflict rules agreed in advance when we serve multiple firms in one segment.

items.zh: 這個職缺是新編制還是補人？上一任待多久、為什麼離開？
items.en: Is this a new headcount or a backfill? How long did the last person stay, and why did they leave?

items.zh: 薪酬結構怎麼組成——本薪、分紅、股票、輪班津貼各佔多少？
items.en: How is the package built — base, bonus, equity and shift allowance?

items.zh: 技術條件裡哪些是真的必要，哪些是「有更好」？
items.en: Which technical requirements are genuinely mandatory, and which are nice to have?

items.zh: 面試流程幾關、決策者是誰、最快多久能給 offer？
items.en: How many interview rounds, who decides, and how fast can an offer issue?

q.zh: 你們會不會從我們公司挖角？

a.zh: 不會。合作期間你的公司列入利益迴避範圍，我們不會主動接觸貴公司的員工。迴避的範圍（是否含關係企業、海外據點）與存續期間，都會在簽約前明確寫入合約，而不是口頭保證。
a.en: No. While we are engaged, your company is off-limits and we will not approach your employees. The scope — whether it covers affiliates and overseas sites — and the duration are written into the contract before we begin, not promised verbally.

q.zh: 人選有競業條款，還能挖嗎？
q.en: Can you move a candidate who has a non-compete?

a.zh: 要看條款的具體內容。台灣法院對競業禁止條款的審查有明確標準，包括是否有補償措施、限制期間與地域範圍是否合理。我們會在推薦前確認人選的條款狀況並如實告知你風險，必要時建議延後到職或調整職務範圍。我們不會為了成交而隱瞞這件事，也不提供法律意見——涉及爭議時建議雙方各自諮詢律師。
a.en: It depends on the clause. Taiwanese courts apply clear tests to non-competes, including whether compensation was provided and whether the duration and geographic scope are reasonable. We verify a candidate's situation before shortlisting and tell you the risk honestly — sometimes recommending a later start date or an adjusted scope. We will not hide this to close a deal, and we do not give legal advice; where a dispute is possible, both sides should take their own counsel.

q.en: How fast can we see candidates on an urgent role?

a.zh: 取決於稀缺度。成熟製程的資深工程師通常數個工作天內可提出第一批；先進封裝研發、特定製程整合或廠級主管這類職缺，市場上符合條件的人可能只有數十位，需要更長的接觸與說服時間。我們會在需求訪談當下給你一個誠實的時程判斷。
a.en: It depends on scarcity. For senior engineers on mature nodes, a first shortlist usually follows within days. For advanced packaging R&D, specific integration roles or plant leadership, the qualified population may be only a few dozen people and takes longer to approach and persuade. You get an honest timeline at the briefing.

q.zh: 海外廠的職缺你們也做嗎？
q.en: Do you cover our overseas sites?

a.zh: 做。台灣半導體客戶在新加坡、馬來西亞檳城與越南設點的需求持續增加，這正是 HRK365 新加坡背景的用武之地：台灣端的幹部派駐與當地招募可以一起規劃，當地的雇用形式與薪酬結構我們也講得出來。
a.en: Yes. Taiwanese semiconductor clients keep expanding into Singapore, Penang and Vietnam, and this is where our Singapore background earns its keep: expatriate assignments from Taiwan and local hiring can be planned together, and we can explain local employment models and pay structures rather than guessing.

title.zh: 把最難的那個缺給我們
title.en: Give us the hardest role on your list

body.zh: 好找的職缺誰都能做。真正能看出差別的，是那個開了半年還沒補上的位置。
body.en: Anyone can fill the easy ones. The role that tells you who is worth working with is the one that has been open for six months.
